basic_details.short_information: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) will hold a walk-in interview on 30.11.2026 at 10:00 AM at ICMR Headquarters, New Delhi, and candidates who do not report on the specified date and time will not be allowed to participate under any circumstances. ICMR, an Autonomous Body under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, intends to engage 01 Senior Consultant (Scientific/Technical – Non-Medical) purely on a contractual basis, at consolidated emoluments of 1,00,000-1,80,000 per month.

important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project requirements. Selected candidates shall have no claim to regular or permanent employment with ICMR or for continuation in any other project. The working hours will be the same as regular employees of ICMR. No extra benefit is allowed for working beyond office hours. Unauthorized absence for a continuous period of 08 days without valid reasons will lead to automatic termination of the engagement. TA / DA for domestic tours for official work is admissible to Consultants as per ICMR Guidelines (as amended from time to time). No TA / DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post. Candidates must make their own arrangements for stay during the interview and, if selected, after joining. Leave entitlement: 08 days in a calendar year on pro-rate basis, and 02 Restricted Holidays as per the rules of Government of India / ICMR. Un-availed leaves are not carried forward to the next calendar year. Compensatory leave is available in lieu of duty on holidays, but not more than 02 leaves can accrue in a month. It can be accumulated only up to 05 days at a time and may be availed within three months. Canvassing or bringing external influence in any form will result in disqualification, and the candidate will be debarred from the recruitment process. ICMR may accept or reject any application without assigning any reason. It may fill or not fill the post and may cancel or modify the selection process at any stage. The decision of the Competent Authority is final and binding. All applicable taxes, as per government rules and regulations, will be deducted at source. Any addendum or corrigendum will be published only on the ICMR website, https://www.icmr.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research is an Autonomous Body under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. Its office is at V. Ramalingaswami Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029. The engagement is for short term support in the activities of the ICMR's Extramural Research Programs Division.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternatives: Professionals having proven competency and success in their area of specialization, with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience and minimum Post PhD experience of 7 years in relevant subject; OR Retired Government employees, with requisite qualification and who were in the regular Pay Level-10 and above and having at least 10 years experience in the required specialization. The age limit is 40 to 70 years. The notice prints no "as on" date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. The consolidated emoluments are 1,00,000-1,80,000 per month. For a retired Govt. servant, the remuneration shall be fixed in accordance with Ministry of Finance, Dept. of Expenditure OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09 Dec 2020. The Selection Committee will decide the amount on the basis of educational qualification, experience and performance in the interview. The tenure is one year and may be extended as per the requirement. The place of work is ICMR Headquarters, New Delhi. Selected candidates will normally be posted at ICMR Headquarters, but they may be assigned duties at any location in India.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: ICMR's extramural research programs comprise investigator-initiated, ICMR-initiated, and ICMR-institute initiated research programs of varying scale. This is the job requirement as printed in the notice. The engagement is for short term support in the activities of the Extramural Research Programs Division.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Documents to be shown for verification on the day: All original documents: educational certificates from 10th class onwards, experience certificates, age proof, caste certificate, and valid photo ID such as Aadhaar / Passport / PAN / Driving License. Documents to be submitted at the time of the interview: Two sets of self-attested copies of all the original documents. A duly filled and signed application form (prescribed format attached as Annexure) with a recent passport-size photograph. Resume. Incomplete or unsigned applications, false or incorrect information, or failure to submit the required self-attested documents will result in rejection without any further consideration at any stage of the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Short-listing for the interview will be based on educational qualifications, age, and relevant experience. If required, a written test or assignment may be conducted prior to the interview. In the event of a tie at any stage, all candidates with the same score will be considered eligible for the subsequent round. Final selection will be based on performance in the interview. Meeting the essential criteria does not guarantee selection. ICMR reserves the right to prepare a waitlist panel valid for one year after the due approval of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ICMR walk-in interview for Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30.11.2026 at 10:00 AM at ICMR Headquarters, New Delhi. Candidates who do not report on the specified date and time will not be allowed to participate.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: The notice announces one (01) vacancy for Senior Consultant (Scientific/Technical – Non-Medical) at ICMR Headquarters, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Msc, PhD in Biotechnology of Biological sciences from the recognised University/Institute, with at least 12 years of post-qualification experience and minimum Post PhD experience of 7 years in relevant subject. The alternative is retired Government employees with the requisite qualification, regular Pay Level-10 and above, and at least 10 years experience in the required specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 to 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated emoluments are 1,00,000-1,80,000 per month. For retired Govt. servants the remuneration is fixed as per Ministry of Finance, Dept. of Expenditure OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09 Dec 2020.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Candidates bring all originals (certificates from 10th class onwards, experience certificates, age proof, caste certificate, photo ID) and submit two sets of self-attested copies, a signed application form with a passport-size photograph, and a resume.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Short-listing is based on educational qualifications, age and relevant experience, and a written test or assignment may be held before the interview if required. Final selection is based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual and temporary for one year, which may be extended as per the requirement. Selected candidates have no claim to regular or permanent employment with ICMR.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates in regular government service attend?
faq.answer: No, candidates in regular service under any Central / State Government, Autonomous Body, Department or PSU are not eligible to apply. Retired Government employees who meet the Pay Level-10 and experience conditions may attend.

faq.question: Q10. Will ICMR pay travel allowance for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA / DA is paid for attending the interview or joining the post. Candidates must make their own arrangements for stay.
